question: Which of the following is an advantage of LAN?
solution:
The correct answer is __**sharing peripherals**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sharing peripherals** is a significant advantage of a Local Area Network (LAN).
 
• LANs allow multiple computers and devices to share resources such as printers, scanners, and storage devices.
 
• This sharing capability can lead to cost savings by reducing the need for multiple peripheral devices.
 
• It also enhances efficiency and convenience, as all connected devices can access shared peripherals without the need for physical transfers or manual connections.
 
• LANs are commonly used in offices, schools, and homes to create a networked environment for resource sharing and communication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **Local Area Network (LAN)** is a network that connects computers and devices within a limited geographical area such as a home, school, or office building.
 
• LANs can be established using wired (Ethernet) or wireless (Wi-Fi) connections.
 
• They provide high-speed connectivity and are essential for enabling communication and resource sharing within a localized environment.
 
• Other advantages of LANs include improved data security, easier data management, and enhanced collaboration among users.
 
• LANs can also be connected to larger networks, such as Wide Area Networks (WANs), to extend their reach and capabilities.
